what: When the vertical-writing brush calligraphy SVG title touches the bottom of the screen (once), the letter outlines are drawn as a 1px line (stroke-dashoffset 1000→0, for 60% of the total), and for the remaining 40% the line fades while the inside fills with the text color — both linear curves, 3s total. A section title from Japanese inn and long-established shop sites, where ink writing is traced stroke by stroke and then bleeds in to fill

options.text · path · [data-fx-part=glyph]: SVG text to stroke (inside the title) — required
options.split: Ratio at which the stroke ends (0~1), default .6
options.dash: Line dash length (px), default 1000 — increase it if the text is large
options.start: Position where it turns on, default top bottom (panel head at the bottom edge of the screen)
options.once: ”false” means it draws again each time you scroll back up and down — default once
options.fx:show: Firing this event redraws it regardless of scroll
options.--fx-fill: Line·fill color, default text color (gold headings use var(--kf-accent))
options.draw: Drawing duration (seconds) — if given, used instead of dur×split. For types that draw each letter separately
options.draw-ease: Drawing curve — if given, used instead of ease (School 0,0,0.58,1 = CSS ease-out)
options.fill-at: Seconds from when each character starts drawing until it starts filling, default draw (after fully drawn) — if short, it fills while still being drawn
options.keep: If true, the line is not erased while painting (line and fill share a color — the stroke looks slightly thicker)
options.wait: If true, it isn’t triggered by scroll and draws only when fx:show is fired (the hero heading after the loader)

from.where: Applies to index.html .kh-intro__hd and .kh-omo-kokoro__hd, and on subpages .kh-pconcept__title · .kh-opening__h · .kh-chef__catch (original c-svg-text-animation: svgAnime 3s linear, 0% dashoffset 1000px · stroke 1px · transparent fill → 60% dashoffset 0 → 100% transparent stroke · fill #fff/#c7a569). js-ScrollTrigger adds is-animation when the top of the element reaches the bottom of the screen.

index.html .kg-mv-title — Hero two-line serif drawn title (original SVG Artista: 24 strokes at .05s intervals with stroke-dashoffset 1s ease-out (first stroke delayed .2s), each stroke fills .7s cubic-bezier(.47,0,.745,.715) starting .6s after its own start, is-visible when the loader lifts). With eight letters, the gap is .15s (three strokes’ worth).
from.options: wait: true; draw: 1; draw-ease: 0,0,0.58,1; fill-at: .6; fill-dur: .7; fill-ease: 0.47,0,0.745,0.715; stagger: .15; delay: .2; keep: true
